channel.title: Sagar Vasoya
channel.description: Technical writing on AI systems, typed decisions, and building software with agents.

item.title: What if Jev made a coding agent's small decisions?
item.description: Why handing work to a cheaper model often costs more, and what happens when a decision model like Jev chooses context and permissions each turn.

item.title: Jev, explained: typed decisions instead of generated text
item.description: What TypeSafe’s Jev is, how its three question types work, why it is fast, and why its confidence number is not the same thing as being right.
